summary: The filing is an 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01, reporting the issuance of a press release titled 'AITX's RAD Receives Four-Unit RIO 360 Order for Deployment with One of the World's Most Recognizable Pop Culture Brands.' The press release announces a customer order for four autonomous security trailers placed through an authorized dealer. No financial terms, ownership changes, or corporate actions are disclosed. The filing is purely informational and does not constitute a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. The registrant is the issuer of the filing, reporting routine business development news. No board recommendation, advisor, or structural details are provided. Nothing to watch or risk-arb angle applies.
